# Amazon Q Developer User Guide - Document History (Fetched 2026-05-25)

| Change | Description | Date |
|--------|-------------|------|
| Updated managed policies: AmazonQFullAccess and AmazonQDeveloperAccess | Added q:CreateArtifact, q:GetArtifact, q:GetArtifactActionResult, and q:PerformArtifactAction permissions to enable Amazon Q artifacts (preview). | May 21, 2026 |
| Updated Builder ID unsubscribe instructions | Added guidance for unsubscribing a personal account (Builder ID) when the Amazon Q Developer Profile has been deleted. | March 19, 2026 |
| Updated account limit for subscriptions | You can now subscribe users in a maximum of 20 accounts per AWS Region, per organization, increased from 10. | February 18, 2026 |
| Deprecated code transformation for GitLab | Code transformation capabilities for Java modernization deprecated for GitLab Duo with Amazon Q Developer. | January 16, 2026 |
| Updated GitHub feature development workflow | Now uses conversation-based feedback with the `/q` command. | December 29, 2025 |
| Deprecated code transformation for GitHub | Code transformation capabilities deprecated for Amazon Q Developer for GitHub. | December 15, 2025 |
| Q CLI becomes Kiro CLI | The Q CLI has become the Kiro CLI. | November 17, 2025 |

## Amazon Q artifacts (preview) — chat-artifacts.html
- Q artifacts deliver responses enriched with table and chart visualizations
- Can execute "cross-service jobs (preview)": provisioning infrastructure, connecting services, securing applications across AWS services
- Example: "Connect EC2 instance to an S3 bucket" — Q artifact grants permissions to an S3 bucket in the EC2 instance profile and makes bucket policy changes
- All data associated with Amazon Q visualizations saved in us-east-1
- New IAM actions: q:CreateArtifact, q:GetArtifact, q:GetArtifactActionResult, q:PerformArtifactAction
- Supported services include EC2, RDS, Lambda, S3, etc.
